correctness.rationale: Verified all quantifiers and the exact distance formula; derived the cyclic Fourier sine-sum/product identity, treated removable denominators, checked short-diameter sign witnesses analytically, and reconstructed a universal positive zero-sum quadratic form for the remaining orders. Four exceptional signs and nullities are exact rational-angle arithmetic. Standalone verifier passed independent shortest-path and Fourier tests (finite support only). The Schoenberg equivalence and centered rank argument establish the stated kernel and Euclidean consequences.
